rgielen Helm Charts

Helm charts maintained by @rgielen, released independently from one repository. Written for GitOps consumption, and equally happy under a plain helm install.

Add the repository

helm repo add rgielen https://rgielen.github.io/charts
helm repo update
helm search repo rgielen

Every release is published twice, with identical content: here, and as an OCI artifact at oci://ghcr.io/rgielen/charts/<chart>. Pin an explicit version — for an ArgoCD targetRevision a floating range turns an unrelated upstream release into an unreviewed change in your cluster.
